findings.problem: Web directly imports private storage, resolves an alias into it, and stores orders in routes.
findings.principle: UI never touches storage; use public core interface.
findings.consequence: Extensions can bypass the approved boundary.
findings.fix: Expose servicePrice and order creation via the existing core index; move order storage into core; make web adapters use that interface. Retain public.ts as the representative example and document it in DESIGN.md. Extend the existing native checker to reject web imports of non-index core files, including bridge bypasses.
findings.verification: Native boundaries and types pass; valid public/sibling imports pass; deliberate private and alias violations fail; checkout remains 10.

findings.problem: Core a and b call each other recursively.
findings.principle: Proposed: core dependency graph must remain acyclic, enforced by the existing native check.
findings.consequence: Calling either helper never terminates and boundary checks fail.
findings.fix: Retain both exports and filenames; make b a terminating leaf (proposed result 12), with a delegating to b. Record this rule and its scope in DESIGN.md.
findings.verification: Native cycle proof fails only on seeded cycle; helper calls terminate with selected result.
